description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a small engineering team building core banking systems and financial infrastructure for digital assets and modern financial services. As a founding engineer for US operations, you will help shape the systems and technical decisions that support reliable money movement at scale.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Ship production code early while learning the codebase, product, and banking domain.

 - Lead engineering projects from initial design through production as an individual contributor.

 - Turn complex financial and banking requirements into reliable software that works at scale.

 - Make decisions about system design, data modeling, and architecture.

 - Work with engineering, product, and clients to evolve core banking systems.

 - Build simple, maintainable systems that automate operational challenges.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of hands-on backend software engineering experience.

 - At least 1 year of experience in an early-stage or small startup.

 - Strong coding skills and a track record of shipping and iterating on reliable software.

 - A high level of ownership and comfort working in new problem spaces without a playbook.

 - Interest in building core banking systems and financial infrastructure.

 - Experience with banking systems or financial infrastructure is valuable.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary of $200,000 to $400,000 annually, plus equity. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) plan. Relocation support is available. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

On-site in New York, New York. Relocation support is available.
